ownershipCoverage.rule: Main players are those projected above 0 points who are not listed out; a source is used when the players it names hold at least 80% of their total projected points.

recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of TwoGun x1, TwoGun's own DraftKings projection, used as he publishes it. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. A player no ticked source covers has no projection: it is left blank, flagged "no projection" (0 when the injury report lists him out, on IR, doubtful or suspended); his DraftKings average per game never stands in.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

rows.name: Malik Nabers

injury.comment: Nabers secured five of seven targets for 44 yards and lost a fumble in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.
injury.longComment: The star wideout finished with less than 50 receiving yards for the second time in five days, and Nabers' late third-quarter lost fumble had significant ramifications. The turnover came at the Commanders' 16-yard line with the Giants down by three, costing  New York a golden opportunity to tie the game at minimum. Nabers' aforementioned pair of mediocre performances have come in the wake of a four-game streak of 100-yard efforts in Weeks 4-7, and he'll look to boost his numbers back up against the Jaguars' pass-funnel defense in a Week 11 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 22.

rows.name: Jayden Daniels

injury.comment: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
injury.longComment: It was a up-and-down night for Daniels in the narrow division win, as the third-year quarterback's pair of fourth-quarter interceptions threatened to derail Washington's fortunes. Daniels had the Commanders up by a 17-14 score just past the midway point of the third quarter after tossing one- and 31-yard touchdown passes to Ben Sinnott and Antonio Williams, respectively. However, Daniels subsequently squandered one scoring opportunity by throwing interceptions on back-to-back possessions in the fourth quarter, the first at the Giants' two-yard line. He ultimately made up for it with his game-winning 32-yard scoring strike to Stefon Diggs, marking the quarterback's first three-TD-pass tally of the season. Daniels is up to 1,499 passing yards and a 10:2 TD:INT alongside 280 rushing yards and another pair of scores heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Bengals on Monday night, Nov. 23.

rows.projHow: TwoGun 19.22 is the only source covering Jayden Daniels, his own DraftKings projection, used as he publishes it.

injury.longComment: Diggs paced the Commanders across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his 32-yard catch-and-run touchdown grab over the middle with under a minute remaining sealed the win for Washington. Diggs next takes aim at the Bengals' inconsistent secondary in a Week 11 home matchup on Monday night, Nov. 22.

injury.comment: McCarthy completed 23 of 36 passes for 293 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding six rushes for 34 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.
injury.longComment: McCarthy continued to look like a competent NFL signal-caller in his third start for the Giants, posting a new career high in passing yards and adding a new season high in rushing yardage. McCarthy has displayed excellent chemistry with his top targets, and he'll look to keep his hot streak going against a pass-funnel Jaguars defense in a Week 11 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 22.

rows.name: Isaiah Likely

injury.comment: Likely brought in nine of 11 targets for 127 yards and a touchdown and fumbled once but recovered in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Likely set the pace for the Giants across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his figure in the middle category also was a career high. The veteran tight end now has five double-digit target tallies on the campaign, and Thursday's production, which included a 66-yard catch-and-run touchdown in the third quarter, pushed his season line to a robust 55-575-7 line across nine games. All three components already are career-high figures, affording Likely massive momentum heading into a Week 11 home showdown against the Jaguars on Sunday, Nov. 22.

rows.name: Devin Singletary

injury.comment: Singletary is expected to return to a change-of-pace role Thursday against the Commanders, as Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation.
injury.longComment: Singletary recorded a season-high 23 touches in Skattebo's absence during the Giants' 19-11 win over the Eagles in Week 9 but mustered only 39 yards with all that volume. Prior to that win, Singletary hadn't exceeded six carries in a game this season. Skattebo is expected to lead the backfield in his return, with Singletary likely to feature in passing situations since Tyrone Tracy (hamstring) remains on IR. Greg Desrosiers is also on the roster at RB.

injury.comment: White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
